description: This file defines graph transformation functions for fusion of specific subgraphs related to convolution operations in TensorFlow. It includes functions to fuse resize, pad, and convolution operations into single optimized nodes for improved performance.

methods.name: absl::Status FuseResizePadAndConv(const GraphDef & input_graph_def,const TransformFuncContext & context,GraphDef * output_graph_def)
methods.description: Fuses a subgraph containing MirrorPad and ResizeBilinear operations followed by Conv2D into a single fused resize and pad convolution node.

methods.name: absl::Status FuseResizeAndConv(const GraphDef & input_graph_def,const TransformFuncContext & context,GraphDef * output_graph_def)
methods.description: Fuses a subgraph with ResizeBilinear followed by Conv2D into a single fused resize and pad convolution node with a no-op padding.

methods.name: absl::Status FusePadAndConv(const GraphDef & input_graph_def,const TransformFuncContext & context,GraphDef * output_graph_def)
methods.description: Fuses a subgraph with MirrorPad followed by Conv2D into a single fused padding convolution node.
